Bring a checked keyword sheet back into the data

Source: R/keywords_clean.R
keywords_merge.Rd

Applies the sheet that [keywords_clean()] wrote with `level = "all"`, after a person or a model has filled in its `merge` column, and returns the data frame. The confirmed steps of [keywords_clean()] are applied again, then the sheet: * a `needs_revision` row with `merge` `yes` becomes its `name`; * a `confirmed` row is merged unless `merge` says `no`; with `no` it keeps its own spelling; * an edited `name` renames its whole group; * an empty `merge` keeps what the row's `status` says.

Rows are matched on `keyword_backup` (on `keyword` when a sheet has no backup column). Pass the same `columns` and `replace` as to [keywords_clean()], and the data as it was before cleaning: a confirmed merge marked `no` can only be undone from there (on cleaned data everything else gives the same result).

Usage

keywords_merge(
  data,
  decisions,
  columns = "DE",
  replace = NULL,
  output = c("minimal", "all")
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per paper.

decisions

The checked sheet, `.xlsx` or `.csv`.

columns, replace, output

As in [keywords_clean()].

Value

`data`, same class, rows and columns, with the keyword columns rewritten where they change; with `output = "all"`, plus the `_ORIGINAL` columns. A message reports the counts per column and the rows applied from the sheet.

Errors

Raises `saqrmisc_bad_input` for a missing sheet, one without `name`, `status`, `merge` and `keyword_backup` (or `keyword`), or a `merge` other than empty, `yes` or `no`; and the errors of [keywords_clean()].

See also

[keywords_clean()]

Examples

papers <- data.frame(
  TI = c("Chatbots in class", "Bots that talk", "Fairness at work", "Unfair bosses"),
  DE = c("CHATBOT; NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING (NLP)", "CHAT-BOTS; NLP",
         "INTERPERSONAL JUSTICE", "INTERPERSONAL INJUSTICE; NLP")
)
sheet <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
cleaned <- keywords_clean(papers, level = "all", decisions = sheet, min_papers = 1)
#> keywords: DE: 6 written forms became 5 keywords; 2 papers changed
#> file1e5c5a47b325.csv: 3 groups, 1 confirmed merges (applied) and 2 to check, keywords in 1 or more papers. Fill in `merge` (yes or no), then keywords_merge(data, decisions = "file1e5c5a47b325.csv"). A prompt for a model is in file1e5c5a47b325_prompt.txt.
checked <- utils::read.csv(sheet)
checked$merge <- ifelse(checked$keyword == "NLP", "yes", "no")
utils::write.csv(checked, sheet, row.names = FALSE)
keywords_merge(papers, decisions = sheet)
#> keywords: DE: 6 written forms became 5 keywords; 3 papers changed
#> keywords_merge: from file1e5c5a47b325.csv, 1 merge(s) and renames applied, 1 confirmed merge(s) undone
#>                  TI                                                   DE
#> 1 Chatbots in class                 CHATBOT; NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING
#> 2    Bots that talk               CHAT-BOTS; NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING
#> 3  Fairness at work                                INTERPERSONAL JUSTICE
#> 4     Unfair bosses INTERPERSONAL INJUSTICE; NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING
